name: Bhagavad Gita 14.26
text:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते ।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
meaning: One who serves me with unwavering devotion goes beyond the three gunas and is fit to become one with Brahman.
purpose: Unwavering devotion and moving beyond the gunas.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
